fact: The WHO country cooperation strategy 2024-2028 says the country office will strengthen the health information system including the national health information system (DHIS-2), and notes that regularity, timeliness and quality of published health statistics need improving.
title: Estratégia de Cooperação com o País 2024–2028 Cabo Verde
publisher: Organização Mundial da Saúde, Escritório Regional para a África
